note: Writes corpus.json (the cases) and python-decisions.json (what the Python engine decided for each). Every case runs on a fresh ledger through a GuardEngine built from the installed everyday 0.3.2 pack. A case may `redeclare` an obligation's default_disposition or `add_obligations` (a test- only pack variant; its digest differs). Steps run in order; the last step's decision is compared. A step may carry `task_authority_record`.
